messages:
marta: FYI npm publish for js-sdk failed on the release pipeline. regen diff shows auth types reordered and semver/changelog mismatch, so publish aborted. logs: https://ci/repo/artifacts/1908765432/log.txt
ci-bot: publish job #1908765432 FAILED (exit code 1) — see artifacts above
kevin: ugh. this smells like a breaking change. did typegen change the AuthRetryConfig signature?
marta: yeah — local sampleapp tests show auth retry ctor now expects a different shape. failing in CI too.
liz: reproducing now. running:
```
./scripts/regenerate.sh --openapi packages/js-sdk/openapi.yaml
yarn build && yarn test:sampleapp
```
liz: got same failures, stack snippet:
```
TypeError: opts.retryStrategies is not iterable
    at new AuthClient (/repo/packages/js-sdk/src/auth.ts:42:23)
```
sam: that error indicates the generated constructor now expects an array where we used to pass a map/object. OpenAPI -> typegen change likely reordered/flattened properties.
kevin: who touched the openapi/typegen pipeline recently? @sam any regen diff link?
sam: regen diff: https://ci/repo/regen/1908765432/diff — root cause seems to be property sorting changes when `x-internal` was added to a schema (changed stable sort order)
marta: suggested short-term fixes? :facepalm:
liz: quick hotfix: pin typegen to previous release in packages/js-sdk/package.json, run regen locally, bump patch and republish. buys time.
kevin: long-term: we should add an explicit stable property sort flag in the generator or canonicalize parameter ordering for ctor generation. also add a prepublish check that runs sampleapp smoke tests against regenerated SDK.
marta: release plan options: (A) revert the codegen PR and republish (fast), (B) accept the breaking change and bump major + write migration note, or (C) craft a small compatibility wrapper in the SDK to accept both shapes and do a non-breaking patch.
sam: i'll open a ticket (devex/release blocker) and include the regen diff and failing test cases. assigning to @kevin for triage.
kevin: starting revert PR now. if CI passes we can republish today. :shipit:
marta: creating follow-up issue: https://boards/ISSUE-1234 — will include rollback, tests, and generator tweak task.
liz: note for postmortem: add a regen gating job in CI that runs `yarn test:sampleapp` after any openapi/typegen changes so we catch this earlier :memo:
ci-bot: queued job #1908770430 to run revert-pr workflow
marta: thanks all. will update the release checklist and add migration blurb if we end up pushing a major bump. :thumbsup:
